text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm, Dad's still the comedian as
always. Haha, the kiddos even
wrote
comebacks to his dad jokes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well,
at least it sounds like they liked the
souvenir I sent 'em!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yup. My family even mentions you here.
Take a look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross hands me a page filled with
the handwritten messages. I spot a few
backwards letters in the mix—clearly the
work of her
siblings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every message is about the same
thing—they're all brimming with
pride after
seeing Tamamo Cross run on the tv
program "First Day at Tracen!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri,
Inari and I had a race for this show,
ya see. They said we didn't
needa do it,
but we all ran like it was the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They sure did. Dad's real happy with your
training after seein' that.
He said you made
his little girl into a star!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I better see my White Lightning and her
trainer roarin' through the
competition!"
Got that? Better not disappoint him!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, All right,
I'll let 'im know when I
reply.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, and I wanna send my siblings
some candy too. Mind comin'
with me to
the store?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That way you can pick out the candy we
send. If anythin'll get ya into
their good
books, it's sweets.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've heard good things 'bout these
chocolates. Ah, check it out.
They've got a
peach flavor for a limited time too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at the size of this box of
cookies!
The tikes'll love this! And
the box looks so
fancy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm lookin' 'round... There sure
are a lotta choices. You ever
had any of
these, Trainer? Any standouts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her siblings no doubt have healthy
appetites, so sending them
something they
can eat a lot of sounds like a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right,
then I'll grab these cookies and
some rice crackers too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I'll grab the chocolates as
well. If I budget my money
this month, I
can buy the regular and peach-flavored
ones.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm starving myself or
anythin'.
'Sides, I'm used to livin' on
a budget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I remember one of the
many messages her family
scrawled on
their letter to her.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the tasty candy, Tama.
Didja get a chance to try 'em yourself?
Don't overdo it. You know we'd be happy
with just a phone
call."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's family explicitly told her
to not overdo it. They know
she can't be
leaving much pocket money for herself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
that should do it! I'll get all four!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why would I? Have ya seen Tracen's
cafeteria? I'm eatin' like a queen
every
day!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Livin' any fancier than that would feel
like
a crime!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'd rather see my family eatin'
somethin' tasty than eat it
myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After that,
I got to thinkin' up ways I could
make my family's dreams
come true. And
eventually I landed on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My folks worked hard to get me into this
academy, so I gotta make it
worth the
price! That's why I gotta win! But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear to me that she feels
indebted to her family for sending her
to Tracen
Academy. That's probably why she's
putting them first here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You questionin' my skills?! I'll have ya
know I'm a pro when it comes
to livin' on
da cheap! And what are ya, my mom?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, chill! Geez,
maybe ya really are my
mom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is clearly dedicated to her
family, and it shows in her
races. But I can't
help but feel that she could stand to
indulge herself every once in a while.
